title: Jumping and Splashing
note: b385. 'Cabbage leaf' (p3) reuses the existing 'leaf_single' prop at a large scale rather than a new dedicated prop — it is already a flat single-leaf shape and the story never needs a literal cabbage elsewhere.

pages.brief: Ned mid-air over the pond in a tucked jump, legs pulled in, sheer joy on his face. Below him the log and the rock he has already used. Motion arcs drawn faintly. Bright and splashy.
pages.alt: Ned is mid-air over the pond in a tucked jump, legs pulled in and sheer joy on his face, with the log and the rock he has already used below him.

pages.brief: Pip on a fence post above the pond, entirely dry, wings folded, radiating disapproval. Ned's splash reaching almost but not quite up to him.
pages.alt: Pip sits on a fence post above the pond, entirely dry and radiating disapproval, while Ned's splash reaches almost but not quite up to him.

pages.brief: Fig the green striped caterpillar stretched full length along a warm cabbage leaf in the sun, all his little legs relaxed, eyes shut. Extremely comfortable. Big flat leaf shapes.
pages.alt: Fig the caterpillar is stretched full length along a big warm leaf in the sun, all his legs relaxed, eyes shut, extremely comfortable.

pages.brief: The moment of impact: a wall of water arriving at the fence post, Pip erupting in a flap of shocked feathers and one indignant open beak. Big diagonal splash shape.
pages.alt: The moment of impact: a wall of water arrives at the fence post and Pip erupts in a flap of shocked feathers with one indignant open beak.

pages.brief: Pip hopping about on the fence rail, wings out, water running off his tail feathers, absolutely furious. Ned in the pond below with an innocent expression. Peak comedy.
pages.alt: Pip hops furiously along the fence rail, wings out, water running off his tail feathers, while Ned sits innocently in the pond below.

pages.brief: Fig tumbling sideways off the cabbage leaf, all legs waving, with a small startled expression. A neat little splash below. Everybody else has stopped to look.
pages.alt: Fig tumbles sideways off the leaf, all his legs waving, with a small splash below, while Pip and Ned both stop to look.

pages.brief: Fig lying on the bank in a wet green heap, thoroughly bedraggled, grinning. Ned and Pip either side of him, both dripping too, all three friends again. Warm evening light.
pages.alt: Fig lies on the bank in a wet, bedraggled, grinning heap, with Ned and Pip either side of him, both dripping too — all three friends again in the warm evening light.

pages.brief: Final full-page spread: all three in mid-air over the pond at once, Pip highest of all with his wings spread wide and his eyes shut in delight. Big joyful splash forming below.
pages.alt: A joyful full-page spread of all three friends in mid-air over the pond at once, Pip highest of all with his wings spread wide and his eyes shut in delight, a big splash forming below.
